quiz.q: You have exams next month. What's the right move?
options: Keep signing up and hope for the best
Set Going dark before you go
quiz.say: Going dark covers up to two months a year, with no warnings and your perks carrying on for the first month.

quiz.q: A friend in chat asks you to time out someone they're arguing with. You:
options: Treat it like any other chat moment and follow the ladder
quiz.say: Mod powers aren't for grudges, ours or anyone else's.

quiz.q: How many duties a month keep a Watcher Active?
quiz.say: Two. In months with fewer than 8 streams, it's one.

quiz.q: Someone posts what looks like another viewer's home address. Who do you tell after removing it?
options: Post in chat that you removed it
quiz.say: Personal info is a flag-it moment. Remove, then flag. Never repeat it.

quiz.q: Which chat matters most?
options: YouTube, it needs the most help
quiz.say: We're one crew. YouTube needs more hands right now, but every viewer counts the same.

modules.title: House rules and the escalation ladder

quiz.q: A new viewer posts a link to their own stream. First step?
quiz.say: Start with the gentlest step that works. Most people just didn't know.

quiz.q: Someone keeps spoiling the ending after a reminder and a warning. Next?
quiz.say: Third time is a timeout. Note it in the Mod Deck so the next lead knows.

quiz.q: Which of these skips straight to a ban?
options: Posting in another language (a reminder: English only)
A slur aimed at another viewer
quiz.say: Hate gets no reminder. Ban, then flag.

quiz.q: A viewer says they don't want to be here anymore. You:
options: Ignore it, it's probably a joke
Don't ban; flag Boomer right away
quiz.say: Someone in crisis is never a moderation problem. Flag it now; the Safety module covers what to say.

quiz.q: Someone argues with your warning. Best response?
options: Explain the rule in detail until they agree
Stay short and calm; if it continues, timeout
Argue back so chat sees you're right
quiz.say: Never argue in chat. Short, calm, then the next step.

quiz.q: How many chats does a YouTube mobile stream have?
quiz.say: Two broadcasts, two chats. One lead can cover both from the Deck early on.

quiz.q: Where do Twitch's held messages show up?
quiz.say: AutoMod holds them for a mod to approve or deny.

quiz.q: Who turns on Twitch Shield Mode during a raid?
quiz.say: It changes the whole chat, so it's the Captain's call.

quiz.q: How do you become a TikTok LIVE moderator?
options: Boomer adds you in the TikTok app
quiz.say: TikTok has no way to do it from the site, so it's on Boomer's checklist.

quiz.q: A Chat Game clue just dropped in YouTube vertical, and you lead Twitch. You:
options: Post the clue in Twitch too
Tell Twitch chat a clue just dropped in YouTube vertical
quiz.say: Never repost clues. Point people to the chat that has it; that's the game.

quiz.q: You need 10 minutes away mid-stream. What do you press?
quiz.say: Step away asks a Deckhand to take the lead and hands it back when you return.

quiz.q: When should you drop a seat you can't make?
options: At least 24 hours ahead, on the swap board
quiz.say: 24 hours ahead costs you nothing. No-shows add up.

quiz.q: You open the Deck 20 minutes after the start. Do you get the +5 for showing up?
options: No, that's for clocking in within 15 minutes
quiz.say: You still earn your hourly Gears; only the on-time bonus is missed.

quiz.q: Who becomes Captain if the Captain steps away?
quiz.say: Someone always watches every chat.

quiz.q: Can you help on a stream you didn't sign up for?
options: Yes, drop in from the Mod Deck
quiz.say: Drop-ins earn the same Gears, without the on-time bonus.

quiz.q: A first-time chatter says hi. Best reply?
options: Their name and a hello with a little context
quiz.say: A name and a real hello is what makes people come back.

quiz.q: Chat has been quiet for 15 minutes. You:
options: Post five prompts in a row
Post one question chat can answer
quiz.say: One good prompt beats a wall of them.

quiz.q: A big scare is clearly coming. You:
options: Go quiet and let chat react
quiz.say: Let the moment land.

quiz.q: How do you send people to another chat for a Chat Game clue?
quiz.say: Pointing is the game. Reposting spoils it.

quiz.q: Where do your quick lines live?
options: In the Mod Deck, one tap to copy
quiz.say: The Deck keeps your code, rules, socials and link ready to paste.

quiz.q: Who confirms a task you finished?
options: Someone else (the poster or an admin)
quiz.say: Gears for tasks always need a second person.

quiz.q: Highest badge rarity a Watcher can award?
Where's your chat's check-in code?
You want to swap Saturday's seat. Where?
options: Swap on the duty in HQ

quiz.q: Can you award a badge to yourself?
When does a recruit count?
Is it OK to drop your link in another streamer's chat?
How often can you post your link in our chats?
options: At most once an hour per chat

quiz.q: During Recruit Rush you should push
Do members (not crew) get anything for recruiting?
Your clue is due. You
Twitch asks for clue 2 from YouTube landscape. You
You're the Inside Job culprit. You
options: tell no one, one tell per clue

quiz.q: Why can a small chat win Scream Off?
A bingo square was called by mistake. Who fixes it?
Someone posts a viewer's phone number. First step?
A 15-year-old viewer asks you to DM them. You
options: Kindly say crew don't DM viewers and keep it in chat

quiz.q: A raid floods Twitch chat with slurs. Who decides on Shield Mode?
Someone writes that they don't want to live anymore. You
options: reply kindly with 988, then flag Boomer now

quiz.q: After a heavy moment you need a break. You
options: tell the Captain and pass the lantern

quiz.q: TikTok's tile turns gold mid-stream. You
options: cover it or move a seat

quiz.q: How many times can one badge drop per stream?
A raid hits. First call?
options: Shield Mode / slow mode on the raided chat

quiz.q: Flagging Boomer looks like
After the stream, the Captain
options: writes a two-line wrap-up and rates the game
